page.layout: One printed page, single column of running text. Running head at top right above the text. Page number at top right. Below the text: a rule, then a centred heading "LXII.", a centred heading "Eidem Duci SAXONIÆ", a sub-heading "Epistola sexta.", an italic address line, and the opening paragraph with a large initial S.

main_text.p: statuat, intelligere possim, partim etiam ut Celsitudini V. cruenta Pontificiorum consilia innotescant, qui Principum animos (ut modo Potentissimi Caesaris) in bonorum perniciem inflammare non desinunt, nulla neque juris neque Germanici nominis habita ratione. Deus vero Opt. Max. illorum conatus avertat & Illustriß. Celsitudinem V. ab omnibus adversariorum insidiis ad nominis sui gloriam eripiat.
